notes: Historical values (FY 2023–FY 2025) are taken from audited annual reporting: revenue = PMI net revenues; EBIT = operating income; D&A = depreciation and amortization expense; capex = cash flow capital expenditures. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1413329/000162828026005939/pm-20251231.htm))

NWC definition used for all historical years: NWC = (Total current assets - cash and cash equivalents) - (Total current liabilities - current portion of long-term debt - short-term borrowings). This excludes cash and debt-related current items but includes other operating current assets/liabilities (including income taxes payable). Resulting NWC is negative for all three historical years. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1413329/000162828026005939/pm-20251231.htm))

NWC as % sales and forecast drivers are base-case assumptions only (not reported by PMI) and are set to reflect a gradual working-capital normalization rather than a sudden reversal. (Methodological assumption; no direct citation.)

WACC is set to 0.065 based on market-data discount-rate summaries (used as an input anchor, then rounded). Model users should recalibrate if they have a preferred WACC framework. ([valueinvesting.io](https://valueinvesting.io/PM/valuation/wacc))
Terminal value uses Gordon Growth (terminal_exit_ebitda_multiple is null) with terminal_growth = 0.02.

NOL modeling: PMI discloses deferred tax assets for 'net operating loss, tax credit, and other carryforwards' but does not provide a clean standalone pre-tax NOL balance in the retrieved text; for pipeline compatibility, nol_balance is proxied using the disclosed deferred tax asset amount attributable to those carryforwards. nol_utilization_pct is assumed at 0.80. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1413329/000162828026005939/pm-20251231.htm))

Comps: forward EV/NTM revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, and P/E NTM were not reliably retrieved from high-quality sources within the available tool bandwidth; those fields are set to null for all peers, and the comp section should be completed downstream with an appropriate market-data provider.

catalysts: Sustained smoke-free shipment and net revenue growth (e.g., IQOS, ZYN, VEEV scaling and market expansion). ([philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com](https://philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com/static-files/e7d95e79-6c3f-42bd-bf94-7539938ab720))

Margin expansion follow-through as transformation becomes increasingly profitable (supported by 2025 operating margin narrative). ([pmi.com](https://www.pmi.com/investor-relations/press-releases-and-events/2025-q4-and-full-year-results/))

Execution against PMI’s renewed 2026–2028 growth targets and any mid-cycle updates to those targets. ([philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com](https://philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com/static-files/e7d95e79-6c3f-42bd-bf94-7539938ab720))
company_overview: Philip Morris International Inc. (PMI) is a holding company whose subsidiaries manufacture and sell cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, e-vapor, and oral smokeless nicotine products. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1413329/000162828026005939/pm-20251231.htm))

PMI reports results and manages performance across geographic segments (Europe; South & Southeast Asia, CIS & MEA; East Asia, Australia & PMI Global Travel Retail; Americas). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1413329/000162828026005939/pm-20251231.htm))

PMI’s 2025 performance reflected a continued shift of adult smokers to better alternatives, with smoke-free business scaling materially. ([philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com](https://philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com/static-files/e7d95e79-6c3f-42bd-bf94-7539938ab720))
current_context: Full-year 2025 net revenues were about $40.6 billion, with smoke-free business net revenue at about $16.9 billion (~41.5% of total). ([pmi.com](https://www.pmi.com/investor-relations/press-releases-and-events/2025-q4-and-full-year-results/))

PMI reported strong operating progress: adjusted operating margin returned above 40% in 2025 and full-year reported operating income was about $14.9 billion. ([pmi.com](https://www.pmi.com/investor-relations/press-releases-and-events/2025-q4-and-full-year-results/))

In its Feb. 6, 2026 outlook materials, PMI reiterated growth targeting for 2026-2028 alongside 2026 full-year forecast EPS ranges. ([philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com](https://philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com/static-files/e7d95e79-6c3f-42bd-bf94-7539938ab720))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth is a moderation from the 2023–2025 step-up, consistent with PMI’s mature combustible base plus ongoing smoke-free mix gains. ([philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com](https://philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com/static-files/e7d95e79-6c3f-42bd-bf94-7539938ab720))

Base-case EBIT margins trend toward ~37%+ supported by sustained transformation benefits highlighted in 2025 results. ([pmi.com](https://www.pmi.com/investor-relations/press-releases-and-events/2025-q4-and-full-year-results/))

Capex is held broadly in line with recent levels (roughly ~3.9% of sales) reflecting continued manufacturing investment priorities in smoke-free products. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1413329/000162828026005939/pm-20251231.htm))

Working-capital remains structurally negative under the model’s NWC definition, and base-case normalization is gradual rather than reversing sharply. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1413329/000162828026005939/pm-20251231.htm))
key_risks: Regulatory and excise-tax changes that reduce combustible competitiveness or constrain smoke-free commercialization. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1413329/000162828026005939/pm-20251231.htm))

Competitive intensity in heated tobacco and nicotine pouch categories leading to slower volume/mix gains than modeled. ([philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com](https://philipmorrisinternational.gcs-web.com/static-files/e7d95e79-6c3f-42bd-bf94-7539938ab720))

Macro/geopolitical and FX impacts on working capital timing and reported profitability given PMI’s global footprint. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1413329/000162828026005939/pm-20251231.htm))

presentation.subtitle: PMI: Smoke-Free Mix Expansion Supporting Margin Resilience (DCF Inputs)
valuation_summary: DCF inputs use audited annual historicals (FY 2023–FY 2025) for revenue, operating income (EBIT), D&A, capex, and a consistent NWC construct. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1413329/000162828026005939/pm-20251231.htm))

The discount rate (WACC) and terminal assumptions are set to economically sensible long-run values for a mature global consumer staples business. ([valueinvesting.io](https://valueinvesting.io/PM/valuation/wacc))
Terminal value is generated using a Gordon Growth approach with terminal growth set at 2.0% (no terminal exit multiple required).
